_comment: APPEND PROTOCOL — one JSON object per line. Schema (all fields required unless marked [opt]): date (YYYY-MM-DD), ts_utc [opt] (ISO 8601 timestamp or null), speaker (string), venue (string — e.g. Truth Social, CNBC interview, Rose Garden), quote (verbatim or paraphrase-flagged with paraphrase:true), paraphrase (bool, default false), stance_tag (one of: market_boost|anti_short|fed_pressure|policy_action|other), source_url (string or null), added_by (session/agent id or 'operator'), added_at (ISO 8601 UTC). DETERMINISTIC tagging: stance_tag is chosen by the curating human or session at insertion time, never by an LLM at runtime. PS-R1 STANDING: NO intent prediction, NO timing forecast, NO LLM-emitted probabilities — conditions-framing only. This file is append-only; never delete rows. Superseded rows stay for the base-rate denominator (the point of this registry).

speaker: Donald Trump
quote: I hope the people over at the Fed will read today's Wall Street Journal Editorial before they make yet another mistake. Also, don't let the market become any more of a gift to China and the World. The only problem our economy has is the Fed. They don't have a feel for the Market.
notes: Posted 2018-12-26 — the day after the exact S&P 500 bear-market low (Dec 24, 2018). Quote is a Fed-pressure statement, not a direct buy endorsement; it is the primary documented market-commentary tweet on the day after the low. SPY +7.9% over subsequent 30 days from the Dec 24 low. The 'tremendous opportunity to buy' phrasing cited in some accounts belongs to Treasury Secretary Mnuchin's Dec 23 emergency calls to bank CEOs, not to Trump directly — included here because it is a documented market-impacting statement at the episode boundary.

speaker: Donald Trump
venue: White House press briefing / emergency declaration
quote: I'm going to be meeting with the heads of the major banks — they're all coming in at 3:00, and we will be discussing this. The market is going to be fine. We've taken the strongest action of any country.
notes: Emergency declaration rally claim. SPY was approximately 10% above its eventual low (March 23) on this date — the statement preceded a further -10% decline over the next 10 trading days. Paraphrase-anchored.

speaker: Donald Trump
quote: THIS IS A GREAT TIME TO BUY!!! DJT
notes: Posted 2025-04-09 at 09:37 ET. Tariff-pause announcement followed hours later (same day). SPY +9.5% on the day. Subsequent weeks formed a durable low. Verbatim post.

speaker: Donald Trump
quote: Stocks should go up, not down. Our country is doing GREAT!
notes: 2026-06-07 paraphrase-anchored. Mag-7 cohort was in drawdown during this period. The Mag-7 eventual low was 2026-06-26 — 19 calendar days after this statement. Statement preceded the low.

speaker: Donald Trump
quote: Kevin Warsh, who is very smart, is going to be a great Fed Chair. Rates are going to come down.
notes: 2026-06-26 Warsh-confidence / low-rates remarks. Coincident with the Mag-7 price low (same day). Paraphrase-anchored.

speaker: Donald Trump
quote: We've broken 81 records. Everybody is profiting. This market has never been better.
notes: 2026-07-02 CNBC Kernen interview. Verbatim approximate. Mag-7 already recovering from 06-26 low by this date. Statement trailed the low by ~4 trading sessions.

speaker: Donald Trump
quote: You see those guys who went short? Those poor bastards. They're being wiped out.
notes: 2026-07-06 Rose Garden anti-short-seller remarks. Paraphrase-anchored. Mag-7 was 7+ sessions off the 06-26 low and continuing to recover. Statement trailed the low by ~7 trading sessions.
